# ADR-022 — Reconcile GitHub assets before publishing · summary

**Status:** Accepted · **Date:** 2026-09-09

Create or reuse one approval-bound GitHub draft, upload only missing assets,
download and hash every remote asset, run smoke against downloaded bytes, and
publish only after verification. Never use clobber or deletion as recovery.

Publication has no service activation. Rollback is a separately approved,
superseding release that preserves the original audit evidence.

- **Full doc:** docs/adr/ADR-022-github-release-reconciliation.md
